claim_text: Eight defendants in case 22-CR-226, previously listed in this corpus only as 'charged,' pleaded guilty per a Hiiraan Online tracker: Haji Osman Salad (Haji's Kitchen) pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud, admitting he stole $19 million and pocketed $11.4 million, and agreed to pay $11.4 million in restitution; Anab Artan Awad (Multiple Community Services) pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud for fraudulently obtaining $9.3 million, admitting she served only a fraction of the 3.8 million meals claimed; Sharmarke Issa (Minnesota's Somali Community, and separately a former board chair of the Minneapolis Public Housing Authority) pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud and agreed to pay $3.6 million in restitution; Farhiya Mohamud (Sharmarke Issa's mother) pleaded guilty to one count of money laundering, admitting she should have known money she received from co-defendants Haji Salad and Fahad Nur was criminally derived, with a recommended one-year probationary sentence; Kawsar Jama pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud tied to a Pelican Rapids food site claiming to serve more children daily than the city's population, and agreed to pay just over $1.3 million in restitution; Abdikadir Kadiye (Hobyo Health Care Foundation) pleaded guilty to wire fraud, admitting he stole more than $1 million via invented children's names, and agreed to pay $876,897 in restitution, with no sentencing date set as of the source's publication; Abdulkadir Awale pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud, admitting he stole more than $11 million across three restaurants, and agreed to pay more than $2 million in restitution; Khadra Abdi (Shafi'i Tutoring & Homework Help Center) pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud, fraudulently claiming close to $3.5 million in reimbursements.

supporting_passages.quote: Haji Salad... pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud... He agreed to pay $11.4 million in restitution... Farhiya Mohamud... admitted in court that her son, Sharmarke Issa, who also pleaded guilty in the case, directed her to buy real estate for him using money she received from co-defendants Haji Salad and Fahad Nur.
